title: Speaking practice (hard): University library and choosing a career
author: toefl-claude-test-generator
description: Listen and repeat at a university library help desk (dense with articles and relative clauses); an interview on work and choosing a career that requires comparing, justifying and speculating.

tasks.setting: You are starting work as an assistant at a university library help desk. Listen to the head librarian and repeat exactly what you hear.

items.text: The help desk opens at eight.
Students can borrow up to twenty books at a time.
We'll show you how to renew a loan and reserve a study room.
If a book is already checked out, you can place a hold on it online.
The rare books on the top floor can't leave the building, but students may read them in the reading room.
Anyone who hasn't returned a laptop by the end of the day will have their borrowing rights suspended for a week.
When a student asks for an article that we don't have, you should explain how the interlibrary loan service works.

tasks.intro: Hello, and thanks for taking part. I'm interviewing people about work, and about how they decide what kind of career they want.

questions.text: To start, what kind of job or career are you hoping to have in the future, and what first made you interested in it?
Tell me about a time when you had to work with other people to finish a difficult task. What was your role, and what did you learn from the experience?
Some people would rather have a job with a high salary, while others would choose work they enjoy even if it pays less. Compare these two choices and explain which one makes more sense to you.

Many experts predict that technology will replace a large number of today's jobs within twenty years. How do you think this will change the way young people should prepare for their careers? Please explain your view.
